lines.japanese: 「クリスマスイブを一緒に過ごしますよ。日和子さん共々、もうマスターにも伝えてありますし」
lines.english: “We're spending Christmas Eve together. Hiyoko and I already told the boss.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、２４日。そういや店長から聞いてたわ──」
lines.english: “Oh, the twenty-fourth. The manager did mention—”

lines.japanese: 「──って、そうだ言おうと思ってたんだ。おまえ２４日ったら、一年でいちばん忙しい日だよ」
lines.english: “—wait, that's right. I meant to tell you. The twenty-fourth is our busiest day of the year.”

lines.japanese: 「千歳ってたしか、繁忙期のヘルプってことで、うちの手伝いに来てンでしょ？　いちばん忙しいときに、本人いないどころか、働き手まで一人持ってっちゃってどーすんだよ」
lines.english: “You came here to help during the busy season, didn't you? What are we supposed to do when you're not only absent on the busiest day but taking another worker with you?”

lines.japanese: 「すみません、コラムの方のバイトの絡みで、どうしても折り合いつかなくて……」
lines.english: “Sorry, with my column-writing job, I just couldn’t make the schedules line up any other way...”

lines.japanese: 「いーや、店長が認めても私が認めないね。２４日、ちゃんと出勤しな。それか、私にも誰か紹介してくれるなら休んでもいいよ」
lines.english: “I don't care if the manager approved. I don't. Show up on the twenty-fourth. Or introduce me to somebody, and I'll allow your day off.”

lines.japanese: 「こ、このお姉さまは……」
lines.english: “Th-this woman...”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そしたら私にもー！」
lines.english: “Oh, me too!”

lines.japanese: 「お姉さま方……」
lines.english: “Ladies...”

lines.japanese: 一瞬、フレイムバーズの皆さんでも紹介したろかと思いましたが、それはそれで馴染んでしまい、挙句に俺が店長の恨みを一身に受けそうなのでやめました。
lines.english: For an instant, I considered introducing them to the Flame Birds. But they would probably fit right in, and I would ultimately become the sole target of the boss's resentment, so I reconsidered.

lines.japanese: 「──なんてな。まあ、千歳なりに考えてンならいいか」
lines.english: “—kidding. If you've put real thought into it, fine.”

lines.japanese: 「だね。あとは千歳君の愛を信じて帰ろっか」
lines.english: “Yes. Let's trust in Chitose's love and go home.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃーな。たまひよ泣かせんじゃねーぞ」
lines.english: “See you. Don't make Tama-chick cry.”

lines.japanese: 「はい。ご忠告はありがたくいただきました」
lines.english: “Understood. I gratefully accept the warning.”

lines.japanese: そして紀奈子さんと英里子さんは店を出ていかれました。
lines.english: Then Kinako and Eriko left the restaurant.

lines.japanese: あらやだ、かわいい後輩をふたり残して先に帰っちゃうとは──
lines.english: My, my. Leaving two adorable juniors behind and going home first—

lines.japanese: ──なんて親切な先輩方なんでしょう。
lines.english: —what considerate senior coworkers they were.

lines.japanese: ふっと息を吹きあげて、前髪を揺らします。
lines.english: I puffed a breath upward and stirred my bangs.

lines.japanese: よし。
lines.english: All right.

lines.japanese: 「ぬるっと行こう！」
lines.english: “Let’s keep it slippery!”

lines.japanese: 足取りも軽く、階段を上っていきました。
lines.english: With a spring in my step, I climbed the stairs.
